conversation_starters.title: Major highway closures underway this weekend at LP 1604, I-10 on north west side
conversation_starters.summary: The closures are scheduled to remain in place until 5 a.m. Monday as part of bridge demolition work for the North Expansion Project on Loop 1604, the outer highway loop that circles San Antonio.
questions: Have the Loop 1604 closures changed how you get around?
Is the 1604 expansion work something you notice day to day?
